issue.title: Align Expo SDK 57 patch dependencies via expo install --fix
issue.body:
## Problem

Dependabot cleanup (2026-08-11) found Quality Gates failing on all rebased bot PRs with Expo SDK patch drift:

- `expo` 57.0.11 → expected ~57.0.12
- `expo-asset` 57.0.9 → expected ~57.0.10
- `expo-build-properties` 57.0.9 → expected ~57.0.10
- `expo-constants` 57.0.9 → expected ~57.0.10
- `expo-dev-client` 57.0.10 → expected ~57.0.11
- `expo-updates` 57.0.12 → expected ~57.0.13
- `jest-expo` 57.0.3 → expected ~57.0.4

This blocks merging safe Dependabot PR #312 (`babel-preset-expo` patch).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run `npx expo install --fix` so packages match Expo SDK 57 expected versions
- [ ] `npm run doctor` passes locally
- [ ] CI Quality Gates (TypeScript, expo-doctor, expo install --check) green
- [ ] Document Dependabot batch resolution in `docs/guides/dependabot-resolution-log.md`
- [ ] After merge, rebase Dependabot #312 so it can be squash-merged

## Notes

Per dependabot-workflow / delivery rules: agent-authored expo doctor fixes go through a ticketed feature branch + PR — never push to `main` directly.
